research_mode: official Police.uk sources only; neighbourhood metadata, priorities, events, API transport and stop-search availability semantics; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Neighbourhood centre-point precision
verified_claims: the neighbourhood response can include a centre point
the documentation states the point may not be exactly in the centre
latitude and longitude are locator metadata
limitations: the centre must not be treated as a boundary centroid
a locator point is not parcel-level geography

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Associated neighbourhood locations
verified_claims: a neighbourhood response can include associated locations
the documentation gives police stations as an example
the locations are nested metadata attached to the team response
limitations: associated locations are not crime-event locations
the list may be empty or incomplete

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Neighbourhood location fields
verified_claims: associated locations can contain address and postcode
telephone and location type can be supplied
coordinates and description can also be present
limitations: optional contact fields can be missing
station metadata is not a public-safety score

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Neighbourhood-priority issue contract
verified_claims: a priority record contains the issue raised with police
it includes the date the priority was agreed
the issue and date are separate fields
limitations: a locally raised issue is not a measured incident rate
priority text can be narrative and mutable

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Neighbourhood-priority action contract
verified_claims: a priority record can contain action taken
it contains the date action was last taken
action date differs from the issue-agreement date
limitations: action text is not an independently verified outcome measure
missing action does not prove no police activity

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Neighbourhood event timing
verified_claims: event records can contain start and end dates
the dates are returned in ISO date-time format
event title address and type are separate fields
limitations: scheduled dates do not prove an event occurred
event records are operational metadata rather than crime observations

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Optional event contact details
verified_claims: event records can include contact details
contact channels are optional
description and address are separate from contact information
limitations: absence of contact details is not an event-status flag
contact metadata can age quickly

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police API transport contract
verified_claims: the API is implemented as a standard JSON web service
the documentation supports HTTP GET requests
the documentation also supports POST requests for applicable methods
limitations: transport success does not establish semantic completeness
method-specific limits still apply

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Police API resource scope
verified_claims: the API includes neighbourhood team information
it includes upcoming events and street-level crime or outcome data
it also exposes nearest police-station information
limitations: resource presence does not imply identical update cycles
these resources must not be collapsed into one risk metric

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Force stop-search default-month caveat
verified_claims: omitting the date requests the latest month
the latest month can contain no data for the selected force
the documentation recommends the availability endpoint when date coverage matters
limitations: an empty latest response is not a zero-event conclusion
reproducible queries should pin a month
